request.body:
Hey guys, yesterday around 4:30 PM EST I forwarded about 8 Reddit posts from r/automation and r/SaaS into EverForge. It extracted a bunch of awesome AI workflow tidbits and 3 potential market openings for a niche CRM tool. I carefully organized them, edited a few titles, and saved them into my "Q3 SaaS Ideas" folder in the library.

This morning I logged back in around 9 AM to review them for a meeting with my cofounder and the entire Q3 folder is empty?? Actually it shows 2 items now but they are old items from last week and the titles are changed back to "Untitled YouTube Parsing #14".

I didn't log out or change accounts. Where did my parsed data go? Is there a backup or version history? I spent almost 3 hours sorting those workflows yesterday. Please tell me they aren't gone forever.

candidates.body: opened everforge put youtube link in the input box and clicked process. screen went completely white. tried restarting app same thing happened again. literally unusable right now please fix asap i need to save this workflow video
candidates.title: app crashes when parsing yt video link

candidates.body:
Hi team,

I pasted a reddit thread url into EverForge and hit parse. The summary loaded fine, but when I click the "Extract Workflows" button at the bottom right, nothing happens at all. There's no loading spinner or error popup.

I tried refreshing the browser tab, clearing my cache, and trying a different Reddit post, but clicking that button still does nothing. Am I doing something wrong or is the button disabled? Thanks!
candidates.title: "Extract Workflows" button not responding

request.title: Saved Reddit automation tidbits from yesterday completely vanished / library reset?

response.rationale: The user's saved and edited library data was unexpectedly lost/reverted, indicating a data persistence failure ("Something isn't working") rather than a feature request or question.
